newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-SCOTLAND PLANS UPSET BY HASTINGS INJURY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SCOTLAND PLANS UPSET BY HASTINGS INJURY.

text.p: Scotland's most-capped player Scott Hastings has suffered a knee injury and will miss next month's Rugby World Cup Sevens in Hong Kong.

Hastings, dropped from the test squad this week after winning his 65th cap as a replacement against England, was hurt in a training session at Murrayfield and the captaincy has been transferred to scrum-half Graeme Burns.
Squad: Graeme Burns (captain), Nick Broughton, James Craig, Cameron Glasgow, Duncan Hodge, Derrick Lee, Cameron Mather, Scott Nichol, Nick Penny, Murray Wallace.
